human_understanding_delta: A safe quotient chord is not lost under cyclic lifting: the q-th-root lift of a line segment has length at most the sum of the 1/q powers of its endpoint moduli.  In line coordinates this is the antitone kernel bound (d^2+x^2)^((alpha-1)/2)<=|x|^(alpha-1), followed by the exact primitive alpha*integral x^(alpha-1)=x^alpha.  This makes Pendyala's quartic close-pair chord branch composable, while his separated four-point radial lemma supplies the other branch.  Hence all translated quartic quotient fibres P((z-h)^q), q>=2, satisfy Erdos #1041.
